name: agent-history
description: Agent History: exports every Claude Code session and its subagents to a folder, and commits and pushes it when the folder is a git repository

exportDir.title: Export folder
exportDir.description: Absolute path (or ~/...) of the folder the sessions are exported to. Git is used when the folder is a git repository.

exportJsonl.title: Export JSONL
exportJsonl.description: Write <uuid>.jsonl for each session and subagent.

exportMarkdown.title: Export Markdown
exportMarkdown.description: Write <uuid>.md for each session and subagent.

includeText.title: Include text
includeText.description: Keep the text of user and assistant messages.

includeToolUse.title: Include tool calls
includeToolUse.description: Keep each tool call with its tool name.

includeToolInput.title: Include tool input
includeToolInput.description: Keep the input of each tool call. Needs tool calls.

includeToolResults.title: Include tool results
includeToolResults.description: Keep tool results. They are the largest part of a transcript.

includeMeta.title: Include meta rows
includeMeta.description: Keep rows Claude Code adds itself: reminders, attachments, system rows, summaries.

autoPush.title: Push after commit
autoPush.description: Push each commit when the repository has a remote.

commitDelaySeconds.title: Commit delay (seconds)
commitDelaySeconds.description: Wait this long after the last export before commit and push, so turns close together make one commit.
